baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two possessed nouns name the person's literal mother and father in a coordinated pair.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mother branch foregrounds bearing and nurture, while the father branch includes fatherhood, causal generation, correction, and nurture. Together they form the nearest two-source dependency rather than merely two entries in a kin list.

activation_trace.role: The bearer-and-nurturer sense keeps mother literal while making gestation and care the bond's operative force.
Fatherhood and parental nurture add causal, corrective, and sustaining care, completing the paired dependency.

changed_reading.before: Mother and father are simply two immediate relatives.
changed_reading.after: The pair names the person's two nearest sources of embodied life and care, so separation from them is separation from constitutive dependence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Mother and father remain literal parents, but their two root inventories distribute different source-functions across the pair.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mother can carry origin, gathering point, and reference; father can carry causation of existence or rectification. Their coordination compresses provenance into an asymmetric source pair: matrix and reference beside formative cause.

activation_trace.role: The origin-and-reference sense makes mother the point from which identity begins and to which it is gathered back.
The branch explicitly admits one who causes existence or rectification, assigning father a formative causal role.

changed_reading.before: The verse names two biological relations.
changed_reading.after: It can also name a doubled provenance: an originating reference and a formative cause from which the self cannot normally detach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The surface mother and father stay personal, while the mother-root's community, followed-way, and exemplar branches and the father-root's corrective nurture remain latent.
baseline_models.mechanism: Literal parents can function as the first human carriers of collective belonging, customary direction, and exemplarity. On this reading the pair is not replaced by abstractions; it embodies the inherited social and directional order into which a person is formed.

activation_trace.role: The gathered-community sense widens mother from one relation to the belonging transmitted through that relation.
The followed-way sense supplies inherited practice and orientation as a second layer of maternal sourcehood.
The leader-or-exemplar sense makes a parent a lived model rather than only an ancestor.
Corrective parental nurture gives the inherited order a formative agent in the father.

changed_reading.before: The pair consists only of two persons from whom one might flee.
changed_reading.after: The literal parents may simultaneously embody inherited community, way, and formative authority, making the flight a rupture with transmitted orientation as well as affection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's chosen turning-away and distraction around one deemed self-sufficient return at the end as universal, compelled self-enclosure: each person's own affair is sufficient to occupy him, and bodily flight reaches the two people who embody nearest dependence. The parents thus measure the distance between misallocated attention and the final incapacity for any outward attention.

activation_trace.role: Maternal bearing and nurture establish the strongest ordinary claim on attention and care.
Paternal generation and nurture complete the relation against which self-enclosure is measured.
Turning the back supplies a chosen mode of relational withdrawal at the opening.
Sufficiency frames the socially favored person as needing no one, setting the first form of closed independence.
Occupation by one thing away from another names the diverted attention that the ending intensifies.
Literal escape converts earlier withdrawal into bodily flight and grammatically governs the coordinated parents.
Sufficiency now belongs to each person's consuming affair, closing attention around the self rather than marking social privilege.

structural_cues: The opening social withdrawal in 80:1-10 is answered by the kin-flight sequence in 80:34-37.
The same sufficiency root occurs at 80:5 and 80:37 with a changed subject and function.
The preposition governing flight in 80:34 continues through both nouns in 80:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated sufficiency, chosen turning, distraction, final flight, and the parental nurture branches; I infer a reversal from voluntary selective attention to compulsory total self-occupation, with parents as its strongest gauge. A live alternative is that the two scenes merely reuse relational vocabulary without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: Flight from mother and father is a generic sign of terror.
changed_reading.after: It is also the endpoint of the surah's attention problem: an affair now encloses each self so completely that even the sources of one's dependence cannot receive attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence traverses collateral kin, ascendant sources, conjugal companionship, and descendants before collapsing into each individual's burdening affair. Mother and father occupy the hinge between peer relation and the household one builds forward, so 80:35 functions as the generational axis of a whole relational topology.

activation_trace.role: The maternal parent is the bearing and nurturing ascendant at the center of the sequence.
The paternal parent supplies causal and corrective ascendance beside the mother.
Escape is the single motion propagated across every class of relation.
The brother branch contributes a binding tether, establishing the collateral side of the kin map.
Companionship and sustained proximity define the conjugal relation after the parents.
Filiation and attribution to a source establish the descending line that mirrors the person's relation to his own parents.
The branch of dependents and weight turns the universal quantifier into a latent burden-image pressing on every person.
The grave affair supplies the private load that collapses the relational map into isolated individuals.

structural_cues: The list moves brother to mother/father to companion/sons: collateral, ascending, conjugal, then descending relations.
Repeated third-person possessives first maximize relational attachment; the universal singular in 80:37 then isolates each person.
The branchless ص خ خ cue at 80:33 structurally opens the flight scene and is not assigned an invented branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered kin classes, their bond images, one governing flight, and the universal burden afterward; I infer a deliberate generational geometry with the parents as hinge. The live alternative is cumulative rhetoric without spatial or genealogical architecture.

changed_reading.before: Mother and father are one more pair in an escalating family list.
changed_reading.after: They are the pivot where the self's received lineage turns toward the household and descendants it produces, and flight breaks the network in both temporal directions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context reconstructs first emergence from a drop, death, and a later reanimation. The parent pair embodies the human chain of first emergence, but death is branch-imaged as a child's loss to a parent and reanimation occurs after that loss. Flight from mother and father can therefore mark the expiration of parental causality at the threshold of a second emergence.

activation_trace.role: The maternal origin-and-reference sense anchors the parent pair in the person's first provenance.
The father's admitted causation of existence supplies the other human source of first emergence.
Origination of a creature places the parental source-pair inside a larger account of coming into existence.
The fluid branch explicitly includes semen, materially narrowing first emergence to reproductive origin.
Death figured as a child dying to a parent makes mortality a severance experienced from the parental side.
Revival after death supplies a second emergence beyond the first parental chain.

structural_cues: The ordered lifecycle in 80:18-22 precedes the kin-flight scene.
Mother and father are named only after creation, death, burial, and reanimation have been traversed.
The possessive parents remain origins of this person even when their effective reach is lost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reproductive material, origination, a parent-relative death image, and reanimation; I assign the human parents to the first-generation layer and infer that the flight exposes the limit of their causal reach. A live alternative is that the lifecycle asserts a larger agency without setting parental and second emergence in contrast.

changed_reading.before: The person flees those who generated and raised him.
changed_reading.after: The person flees the agents of first emergence at a moment when first-origin relations can no longer mediate the reconstituted life now confronting him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The food sequence runs from feeding through water, receptive fertile ground, growth, forage, and usable provision. Branches within that sequence cross explicitly into male reproductive fluid and human upbringing. Mother and father consequently become the human-scale convergence of conception, bearing, feeding, and cultivation rather than bare genealogical labels.

activation_trace.role: Bearing, feeding, and mother-like rearing anchor the agricultural activation directly in maternal care.
Fatherhood includes nurture and repair, making the father a cultivator as well as a progenitor.
Feeding another supplies the interpersonal transfer by which provision becomes parental care.
The reproductive-fluid scope inside the water root provides the sharp cross-domain bridge from rain to conception in a womb.
Soft fertile ground contributes the receptive and growth-bearing substrate in the cultivation mechanism.
A branch that explicitly joins human growth to upbringing turns sprouting into a model of rearing.
Forage supplies the feeding material that sustains dependent life and anticipates the father's nurture layer.
A usable means for needs closes the sequence as sustained provision rather than a momentary gift.

structural_cues: The command to inspect food in 80:24 opens a causal sequence that ends with provision for humans and livestock in 80:32.
The cultivation block immediately precedes the terminal event and kin-flight block.
The sequence itself supplies rain-to-earth-to-growth; the reproductive mapping is branch-induced rather than stated syntax.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies feeding, reproductive fluid, fertile earth, human upbringing, forage, and provision; I map the agricultural causal chain onto conception and rearing, without equating mother with earth or claiming the domains are identical. The live alternative is a strictly ecological provision sequence that activates parental nurture only by adjacency.

changed_reading.before: Mother and father denote ancestry and affection.
changed_reading.after: They also condense a material care-process: conception, bearing, feeding, and cultivation, all of which the person must now leave despite being made dependent through them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's branch field can make flight initially look like the terminal breach of filial benevolence: favor is covered and a due right is not discharged. The later sufficient affair revises that moralizing first impression. Ordinary filial claims remain real, but the scene depicts their forced suspension under a burden that consumes every person's capacity.

activation_trace.role: Maternal bearing and nurture establish received benefits that ordinarily call for reciprocal care.
Paternal causation, repair, and nurture complete the ordinary field of filial obligation.
Connection and beneficence opposed to filial disobedience supply an explicit parent-directed norm.
Covering a benefit supplies the possible accusation that flight suppresses acknowledgment of parental favor.
Discharging and fully satisfying a right frames what would ordinarily be owed within the parental bond.
The affair that suffices each person supplies incapacity and preoccupation, revising blame into compelled suspension.

structural_cues: The explanatory 80:37 follows the entire kin list and gives a cause for flight.
No word in 80:35 itself labels the flight as filial disobedience or ingratitude.
The moral branch cues precede the lifecycle and kin scenes, allowing an initial charge and a later revision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies filial beneficence, concealment of favor, fulfillment of rights, and final sufficiency; I first assemble a debt model and then let 80:37 reverse its direction from culpable refusal to disabled reciprocity. A live alternative is that these moral branches do not govern the kin list at all and that flight is simply fear.

changed_reading.before: Fleeing one's parents can sound like ultimate ingratitude and failure of filial duty.
changed_reading.after: The scene preserves the weight of that duty precisely by showing a condition in which even this strongest ordinary right cannot be performed, rather than declaring the bond worthless.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mother-root already permits community, followed way, and exemplar, while the father-root permits formative correction. Context then supplies reminder, traversable path, ease, an undischarged right, command, and finally each person's own affair. Literal parents can thus carry inherited orientation, but that inheritance cannot act as a proxy for the individual's unfinished response.

activation_trace.role: The community sense lets the literal mother carry the collective into which the person was formed.
The followed-way sense turns maternal sourcehood into a possible channel of inherited practice.
The exemplar sense gives inherited orientation a person who is followed.
Corrective fatherhood supplies the second parent's formative authority.
A reminder that actively prompts recollection supplies transmissible guidance rather than passive ancestry.
The extended traversable path gives the inherited way a concrete directional mechanism.
Opening and ease after difficulty make the path available but do not perform the travel for the person.
Full discharge of a right defines the completion that the verse's negation withholds.
Binding demand supplies the personal task that inherited guides cannot complete in another's place.
Each person's grave affair finally individualizes the response and removes parental proxy.

structural_cues: The sequence from reminder to path to unfulfilled command precedes the kin-flight scene.
The parents are possessed by the individual, but 80:37 assigns the decisive affair to each individual separately.
This layer depends on branch affordances in the mother root; the surface nouns remain literal parents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mother-root community/way/exemplar images, corrective fatherhood, and a reminder-path-command sequence; I infer that parents can embody inherited orientation whose authority cannot substitute for personal completion. A live alternative is to keep all directional mother branches dormant and read only literal kinship.

changed_reading.before: The person leaves behind two beloved authorities.
changed_reading.after: The person also loses access to inherited community and guidance as a shield: parental formation remains real, but each response has become non-transferably one's own.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the activation comes from the non-dominant split mapping of the blindness root to a different mapped root, not from its dominant sight-loss inventory. It remains valid as a faint association because that supplied branch explicitly concerns paternal kin and the focus explicitly names the father. Render it only as a lineage resonance; do not claim that the blindness word lexically means paternal kin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The father noun can widen from one parent to the paternal kin network attached to him.

activation_trace.role: Literal fatherhood anchors the activation in the named parent rather than in an independent context theme.
The non-dominant split branch names paternal kinship, widening father from an individual to a lineage network.

changed_reading.after: Father carries a faint activation of the whole paternal side, so flight from him may compress flight from an inherited lineage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The 80:31 forage noun and the 80:35 father noun belong to distinct roots, so this is a sound-and-sequence activation rather than etymology. It remains worth carrying because forage closes the provision block, fatherhood explicitly includes nurture, and the two forms occur only four verses apart. Render it as an audible residue that colors parental provision, never as root identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The father noun's own nurture branch receives a provision-colored echo from the nearby forage word.

activation_trace.role: Parental nurture gives the father a genuine feeding-and-rearing anchor before any sound association is added.
Forage contributes the material provision image that the nearby father wording can continue to resonate with.

changed_reading.before: Father primarily marks generation and kinship.
changed_reading.after: Father is heard with a nearby residue of feeding provision, sharpening his role as one who sustains dependent life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because bodily form is a secondary mother-root branch, not the surface sense of mother. It remains anchored because the focus names both formative parents and the context repeatedly moves from completed creaturely form to faces that stand for selves and visibly disclose condition. Render it as an embodied-lineage resonance that is eclipsed by disclosed personal state, not as a replacement gloss for mother.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mother's form-and-appearance branch and father's causal branch allow the pair to register as contributors to the person's embodied likeness.

activation_trace.role: The latent body-form and appearance sense lets mother carry inherited embodiment alongside literal maternity.
Causation of existence makes father the paired formative contributor rather than a detached theme.
Completed and proportioned creaturely form activates the parents as sources of embodied configuration.
The face standing for the self turns visible appearance into disclosed personal identity.
An open, well-formed visage shows personal condition becoming legible on the bodily surface.

changed_reading.before: The person flees the parents whose likeness he may bear.
changed_reading.after: Inherited bodily likeness no longer secures identity: the later face discloses a personal condition that eclipses provenance even while the body still bears parental formation.

strongest_changes: The parental pair becomes the generational hinge of a complete kin topology rather than one item in a list.
The repeated sufficiency root turns the focus into the endpoint of a reversal from selective inattention to compulsory self-enclosure.
Creation, death, reanimation, and cultivation separate parental first-origin from later reconstitution while deepening parents into a conception-to-rearing process.
Filial debt remains live but is revised from culpable abandonment to an ordinary right made impossible by an all-consuming affair.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots combine literal parenthood with origin, community, way, exemplarity, and bodily form, while the context offers unusually exact cross-domain hooks: paternal kin in a non-dominant split, reproductive fluid within the rain-water root, human upbringing within growth, and a distinct-root forage/father sound echo. These activations support several coexisting readings without requiring one final disambiguation.
remaining_uncertainties: The genealogical hinge may be deliberate architecture or simply cumulative kin rhetoric.
The reproductive-cultivation analogy is branch-supported but its directional mapping is reader-supplied.
The inherited-way and embodied-form layers remain lexically distant and should stay qualified.
The paternal-lineage split and forage/father echo are associative activations, not claims of surface lexical identity.
